授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）: 多文化主義理論と（特に東アジアにおける）学校の多文化教育の現状と課題を議論するコースです。
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）: The contemporary world of cultural diversity faces the challenges of accommodating cultural differences and the needs of cultural minorities. This course introduces the challenges and the responses in education by exploring the idea of multicultural education. Starting with the primary questions of what culture is and what multicultural education is, the course invites students to critically examine different ways of addressing cultural diversity in schools and to discuss related educational policies in Asian societies. The course also leads our attention to the more progressive, substantive and demanding notion of critical multicultural education.

授業科目の実施方法について.テキスト:
Readings will be distributed in class, including but not limited to
Banks, J. & Banks, C.(2016) Multicultural Education: Issues and Perspectives (9th ed.). Hoboken, NJ: Wiley.
Nieto, S. (1994). Affirmation, solidarity, and critique: moving beyond tolerance in multicultural education. Multicultural Education, 1(4), 9-12, 35-38.
Neito, S. & Bode, P. (2018) Affirming Diversity: The Sociopolitical Context of Multicultural Education. Pearson.

授業科目の成績評価の方法について.レポート: 50%. Students are required to submit in the last week (Week 8) a course essay in which student examines and addresses a cultural issue of concern in Asian schools. The course essay can be written in English (1000 words) or Japanese (2000 words).
授業科目の成績評価の方法について.発表: 10%. Students are to present their course essays in the last week.
授業科目の成績評価の方法について.授業への貢献度: 40%. This course intends to help students develop an understanding of relevant topics on the basis of individual experience. Students are expected to actively engage in in-class activities such as group work and discussion.
